turns.content: Haha yeah, good to hear from you though! What's been going on? 😄
i don't really know why i'm texting. i just opened this thread and i'm here.
Sometimes that's reason enough. I'm glad you did though. How are you doing, really?
do you remember the project i was working on. the one i kept stalling on.

I wish I could say yes, but I should be honest - I don't actually retain memory between conversations, so I'm starting fresh here. But tell me about it! What was the project? And are you still stalling on it? 😄
i finished it. i don't know if it's good. i'm not sending it to you yet. i just wanted to say it.

That's huge. Finishing it is the hard part, and you did it. Seriously, congrats.

And hey, you don't have to share it. Sometimes you just need to say it out loud first. How does it feel to be done?
